selected_experts.reason: To confirm if the object is taxonomically a cucumber or a look-alike (e.g., zucchini, gherkin) given the smooth skin.
To verify the structural integrity of the hand, specifically checking for fused fingers or incorrect joint angles which are common AI artifacts.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the green fruit and the skin, ensuring they are distinct objects.
To assess overall noise levels, lighting consistency, and subtle texture degradations in the skin and fruit surface.

Surface texture realism of the fruit (specular highlights vs. matte)
